objective: Use the second camera through automatic geometric synchronization, then fill missing tactical ball observations
alignment_inputs: Team-labelled player coordinates only; no ball, no match events, no human labels, no public answer key. Ball coordinates are held out for alignment diagnostics.
algorithm: Team position quantile retrieval, trimmed team Chamfer verification, Hough offset proposals, temporal state decoding, integer frame-offset refinement, monotone run rejection
orientations: Four pitch-axis reflections, determined algorithmically; no manual pitch or temporal correction
synthetic_alignment_check: Independent noisy views of external matches with deterministic cuts, replays and unavailable calibration. Their source frame mapping validates synchronization; no possession labels in alignment.
fusion_variants: same, reject broadcast ball further than 8m from both teams
possession_evaluation: Frozen V6 inference on the same external base view versus augmented view, official spellF1, report per game. Any gain is development evidence, not fresh native confirmation.
challenge_diagnostics: Unlabeled alignment coverage, independent observed-ball agreement, missing-ball reduction. Do not score public competition GT.
public_policy: No competition public or private ground truth loaded or scored
